title: Survives a break
description: Five downswings from 47,044 to 44,688. The downtrend is confirmed at 46,194 on 9 Jan 12:00; an hour later the bounce closes at 46,858, above the previous bounce high (46,644): a bullish market structure break. No upswing breaks structure, so the downtrend carries on and counts one break against it.
